_why: Ratchet floors, ported from sheleg-design after its retro recorded the class: a gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement. Stripping a required section there made the suite drop by one check and stay green. This repository had no ratchet at all until 2026-08-12, so every requirement deletion here was invisible by construction. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
